User.title: User Profile
User.description: Public profile and progression of a user, keyed by their authenticated UID

level.description: Current progressive theme level of the user

gamesPlayed.description: Total words found or grids completed

LeaderboardEntry.title: Daily Leaderboard Entry
LeaderboardEntry.description: Score submission for a specific day, to foster friendly competition

userId.description: User UID who submitted this score

score.description: Score obtained in the word search puzzle

level.description: Difficulty level of the board solved

hintsUsed.description: Number of hints used in this run

completedAt.description: Timestamp when the score was recorded

Activity.title: Community Activity
Activity.description: Global log of player achievements displayed in the community feed

username.description: The display name of the player

text.description: Descriptive text of the completed achievement

/users/{userId}.description: Syncs player profiles and progress across devices

/leaderboards/{dayId}/scores/{scoreId}.description: Daily leaderboard, where scoreId is the userId of the player

/activities/{activityId}.description: Community feed of players' recent achievements
